version: LOCK 72 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - the scholar's notebook, chapter 9: Knowledge and patience
builds_on: LOCK 3 (page 1, read with Idris), LOCK 34 runner, LOCK 51 (the last page). Every reference checked on sunnah.com; the game never shows the reference.

words.find_title: A page in the scholar's hand

words.story: Idris turns back through the pages. “{t}”

chapter.title: Knowledge and patience
chapter.story: His caravan was robbed on the road to Ilmara and his notebook scattered to the wind. He never stopped teaching.

pages.saying: If you hear of plague in a land, do not enter it; if it breaks out where you are, do not leave.
pages.idris: You stayed in Shifara. That was knowledge and courage together.
pages.found: Yunus the muezzin found a page lining an old hat bought from a pedlar.

pages.saying: Whoever lies about me deliberately, let him take his seat in the Fire.
pages.idris: Fuad's strips of paper. A false saying is no small thing.
pages.found: Fuad hands you a loaf wrapped in an old page. “Look at the writing on this.”

pages.saying: The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.
pages.idris: Teach what you learn. Even one verse to one child.
pages.found: Hilal found a folded page in a crack while mending a wall. “It's in a scholar's hand. You'll know who wants it.”

pages.saying: Whoever calls to guidance gets the reward of all who follow it, and whoever calls to misguidance carries the sins of all who follow it.
pages.idris: What you start, others carry on. Start well.
pages.found: Children are flying a kite made from an old page. Malik buys it from them for a date and gives it to you.

pages.saying: Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise; a man keeps telling the truth until he is written as truthful.
pages.idris: Written as truthful. That's a name worth earning.
pages.found: Layla found a page pressed inside a second-hand book.

pages.saying: He is not a liar who makes peace between people by passing on good words.
pages.idris: Adil and Hamza drink tea together now. Good words, not false ones.
pages.found: Zaynab has been using a page to wrap spices and has only just noticed the writing.

pages.saying: Of a found purse: announce it for a year; if the owner comes, give it back.
pages.idris: Umm Salim's ring. Announced, and returned.
pages.found: Kamil pulls a damp page from the bottom of a basket and dries it for you.

pages.saying: No one should stop his neighbour from fixing a beam into his wall.
pages.idris: Nadir's beam rests on Saif's wall now. And they speak.
pages.found: Shakir found a page under a loose floor tile.

pages.saying: Three people Allah will not look at on the Day of Resurrection - among them a man who had spare water on the road and kept it from a traveller.
pages.idris: The water seller at the gate. Water is the first right of a traveller.
pages.found: The innkeeper was given a debt note - and the scholar's page is written on the back of it.

pages.saying: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day should not harm his neighbour, should honour his guest, and should speak good or keep quiet.
pages.idris: Tamim slept on your blanket. You honoured a guest.
pages.found: Yaqub's little one folded a page into a paper boat. Yaqub dried it out for you.
